title: Freight
tagline: Draw the lines. The crates keep coming either way.
description: Depots appear across the map, each one making a shape and wanting a different one. You have three lines and a limited amount of track: connect the depots, let the trains shuttle, and keep the crates moving. Nothing here needs quick hands — it needs a network that still works when the map has doubled in size. When a depot backs up for too long, the whole thing stops.
author: HexCave
controls: Click a line colour, then click depots to route it
Right-click a line to clear it
howToPlay: Run three lines between depots; trains shuttle them on their own.
A train only carries what its line actually reaches.
Depots keep appearing, and a backed-up one ends it.
goal: Keep the network moving as the map grows. Crates delivered is the score, and your best is kept.

1.1.0.notes: In-game coaching: short hints that appear where they are relevant and retire once you have got it.

1.1.1.notes: Hints keep clear of each game’s own controls.
